newsitem.title: USA: LSB sees Q3 hurt by plant work, failures.
newsitem.headline: LSB sees Q3 hurt by plant work, failures.

text.p: LSB Industries Inc said it expects third quarter results to be hurt by down-time at two plants due to emission-control work and mechanical failures.
Chairman Jack Golsen said, "As a result of the curtailed production and the resulting unabsorbed overhead while the work was underway, earnings were adversely impacted in the third quarter."
The company said its El Dorado Chemical unit, a maker of nitrate products, installed new emission abatement equipment at its El Dorado, Ark. plant during the quarter.
In addition, the company said its new direct concentrated nitric acid plant at El Dorado's Arkansas plant "has experienced continued down time due to mechanical failures."

"During this third quarter period, while modifications were being made and while the concentrated nitric acid plant was down, production was significantly curtailed and LSB's consolidated results of operation for the third quarter were adversely affected," the company said.
LSB reported a loss in the third quarter of 1995 of $0.20 per share on $65.5 million in revenues.
Shares in the air conditioning, chemicals and engineering company were unchanged at 3-7/8 bid and 4 ask.
